summary: A luxury Shopify store serving Arabic and English shoppers equally, RTL and payments included.
challenge: Before TDM, the brand Fragrance needed a premium eCommerce platform that could serve both Arabic and English customers while reflecting the elegance of Middle Eastern luxury perfumery.
approach: TDM developed a bilingual Shopify store with RTL Arabic layouts, English localization, mobile-first UX, multi-currency support, and local payment gateways. The platform improved browsing, checkout, and brand storytelling for Dubai, GCC, and international fragrance buyers.

testimonial.quote: TDM created a bilingual luxury Shopify store that made our brand accessible, elegant, and easy to shop for both Arabic and English customers.
testimonial.author: Perfume e-commerce client, United Arab Emirates
